{\sffamily\footnotesize\color{expgrey}EXPERIMENT 12 \textperiodcentered\ TUNING \hfill 2026-11-25}\par
{\LARGE\bfseries\sffamily Perturbation probe: tune all knobs with a significance test}\hfill\verdictbox{expgreen}{KEPT}\par\smallskip
{\itshape Can nudging every knob at random in every game, and moving only the knobs whose up and down games differ significantly, find gains that hill climbing cannot see?}\par\medskip
\begin{tabular}{@{}p{22mm}p{\dimexpr\linewidth-26mm}@{}}
\fact{Change}{A new trainer. Each sample nudges all 205 non-zero knobs up or down by 25\% at random and plays the two opposite variations against each other and against a league; a knob moves half a nudge when its up-versus-down difference reaches z = 3.}
\fact{Knobs}{\knob{26 of 205 knobs moved, 60 steps}}
\fact{Base}{\model{greedy-full-combo} $\rightarrow$ result \model{greedy-full-probe}}
\fact{Method}{Tuning run of 100,000 games (10 rounds) against a hill-climbing control of the same budget; final test 400 games, repeated with 8 players; metric: finish score}
\fact{Setups}{4 players, 16$\times$16, drylands, turn cap 150; 8 players, 20$\times$20, drylands, turn cap 300 (final test only)}
\fact{Record}{issue \issue{89}, pull request \issue{146}; status: done}
\end{tabular}\par\medskip
